findings.title: Revalidate planned fixes after committed changes
findings.description: The apply-time readiness check detects uncommitted edits, but not changes committed while confirmation is pending. Another agent can commit reordered plan entries, leaving a clean checkout; the saved `lineIndex` then updates—and automatically commits—the wrong checkbox. Verify the checked content is unchanged before applying, or regenerate the findings. Add a regression test covering a committed change between planning and application.

findings.title: Preserve JSON output when auto-fix has nothing to apply
findings.description: With `workflow.auto_fix = true`, plain `cf check --json` reaches this branch whenever no fixable findings remain. It prints human-readable text and returns before `printJson`, breaking JSON consumers on clean projects and projects containing only non-fixable findings. Return a structured zero-fix result and let the caller select JSON or text output.
